title: module
description: Multi-die power module (half-bridge, full-bridge, sixpack, chopper, ...) component data. The presence of the 'module' field at the top level of an SAS document discriminates the device type — there is no deviceType property. The circuit arrangement is carried by electrical.topology and the die technology by electrical.switchTechnology; the per-switch ratings reuse the discrete mosfet/igbt electrical shapes by $ref (a module's switch position is the same physics as a discrete device).

spiceModel.description: Device-body SPICE .model card for a simulation-sourced part (no datasheet). Faithful home that does not require manufacturerInfo.

topology.title: moduleTopology
topology.description: Circuit arrangement of the dies inside the module. Value set derived from what vendors actually sell: Digi-Key's IGBT-module 'Configuration' parametric filter (Half Bridge, Full Bridge (Inverter), Three Phase Inverter (+ with Brake), Single (Switch), Single/Boost/Buck Chopper, Dual Common Source/Emitter, 2 Independent, Asymmetrical Bridge, Three Level Inverter, T-Type) plus the Vincotech by-topology catalog (sixpack, sevenpack, PIM (CIB), booster, three-level NPC/MNPC/ANPC).
topology.$comment: singleSwitch = one switch + freewheeling diode; chopper = switch + series diode (incl. brake choppers); boost/buck = boost/buck chopper cells; halfBridge = two switches totem-pole (covers 'Half Bridge Inverter'); fullBridge = H-bridge / fourpack (covers 'Full Bridge Inverter'); dualCommonSource = two switches sharing source/emitter (covers Digi-Key 'Dual, Common Emitter' for IGBTs); dualIndependent = two electrically isolated switch positions; asymmetricBridge = switch+diode asymmetric bridge leg (SRM drives); sixpack = three-phase inverter, 3x half-bridge; sixpackWithBrake = sixpack + brake chopper (sevenpack); pim = power integrated module / CIB: input rectifier + brake + sixpack; threeLevel = three-level leg, any flavour (NPC I-type, MNPC/T-type, ANPC, FC).

switchTechnology.title: moduleSwitchTechnology
switchTechnology.description: Die technology of the main switches. Combines the process (part.technology: Si/SiC/GaN) with the device kind, which for a module is not implied by the family name the way it is for the discrete mosfet/igbt files.
switchTechnology.$comment: Consistency with the shared part def: siliconIgbt/siliconMosfet imply part.technology 'Si', sicMosfet implies 'SiC', ganHemt implies 'GaN'. siliconIgbt switches use the igbt.json electrical shape; the three FET values use the mosfet.json electrical shape (see the if/then on electrical.switch).

datasheetInfo.title: moduleDatasheetInfo
datasheetInfo.description: All information extracted from the power-module datasheet.

allOf.$comment: Device-specific narrowing of the shared part def: subType must come from this closed enum. For modules subType mirrors electrical.topology (same value set); prefer omitting it and relying on electrical.topology.

thermal.description: Module-level thermal data. R_th values are PER SWITCH POSITION as datasheets state them; for baseplate-less modules (e.g. Infineon EasyPACK) the junction-to-case field carries the datasheet's junction-to-heatsink R_th(j-s).

electrical.title: moduleElectrical
electrical.description: Module electrical characteristics: the circuit topology, the switch die technology, the per-switch ratings (reusing the discrete device shapes), the optional separate co-pack diode, and the module-level extras a discrete part does not have (baseplate isolation, integrated NTC, loop-measured switching energies).

numberOfSwitches.description: Number of main switch positions in the module (2 for a half-bridge, 4 for a full-bridge, 6 for a sixpack, ...). Paralleled dies within one position count as one switch.

switch.description: Electrical characteristics of ONE switch position. Shape is selected by switchTechnology (see the if/then below): siliconIgbt -> igbt.json#/$defs/electrical, siliconMosfet/sicMosfet/ganHemt -> mosfet.json#/$defs/electrical. Same physics, same field names as the discrete devices.

diode.description: Ratings of the integrated anti-parallel / freewheeling diode of ONE switch position, when the datasheet specifies a co-pack diode separately from the switch (typical for IGBT modules). For SiC/Si MOSFET modules whose datasheet only characterizes the body diode, use switch.bodyDiode* instead and omit this.

isolationVoltage.description: Isolation test voltage V_isol between baseplate/heatsink side and terminals, RMS at 50/60 Hz for 1 min, in Volts.

ntcIntegrated.description: Whether the module integrates an NTC temperature-sense thermistor.

ntcRatedResistance.description: Rated resistance R25 of the integrated NTC at 25 °C, in Ohms.

ntcBValue.description: B-value of the integrated NTC (B25/100 preferred when the datasheet gives several), in Kelvin.

allOf.$comment: switchTechnology pins the per-switch electrical shape: IGBT-die modules carry the igbt electrical block.
FET-die modules (Si/SiC MOSFET, GaN HEMT) carry the mosfet electrical block.
The NTC detail fields are only meaningful when ntcIntegrated is true.

switchingEnergy.title: moduleSwitchingEnergy
switchingEnergy.description: Per-switch switching energies measured in the MODULE's own commutation loop (they depend on the module stray inductance, so they are module-level data, not a property of the bare die). Canonical home for module E_on/E_off — leave the igbt-shape switch block's own turnOnEnergy/turnOffEnergy unset for modules.

turnOnEnergy.description: E_on per pulse at the stated test conditions, in Joules.

turnOffEnergy.description: E_off per pulse at the stated test conditions, in Joules.

reverseRecoveryEnergy.description: E_rr of the commutating diode per pulse, in Joules.

testVoltage.description: DC-link voltage at which the energies are specified, in Volts.

testCurrent.description: Switched current at which the energies are specified, in Amperes.

junctionTemperature.description: Junction temperature at which the energies are specified, in Celsius.

mechanical.title: moduleMechanical
mechanical.description: Mechanical specs — extends PEAS datasheetInfoMechanical with a package case field and the module terminal style.
mechanical.$comment: Mirrors ./utils.json#/$defs/mechanical (which is closed and cannot be extended from here) plus terminalStyle.

case.description: Package name (SEMITRANS 2, EasyPACK 3B, 62 mm, ...) — mirrors part.case for convenience.

terminalStyle.description: Power/auxiliary terminal technology. Vendor survey: screw (Semikron SEMITRANS, 62 mm packages), pressFit (Infineon Easy PressFIT), solderPin (Vincotech flow), spring (MiniSKiiP/SKiiP), busbar (high-current direct-busbar terminals).

curves.title: moduleCurves
curves.description: Module characteristic curves from datasheet, per switch position.

diodeVf.description: Co-pack / body diode forward characteristic V_F vs I_F

thermalImpedance.description: Z_th(j-c) vs pulse width, per switch
